title: Na academia
text:
— Boa noite! Eu queria informações sobre os planos da academia.
— Claro! Você já fez academia antes?
— Já, mas parei há dois anos. Agora quero voltar, porque passo o dia inteiro sentado no escritório.
— Entendi. O plano mensal custa cento e vinte reais. No plano anual, você paga cem reais por mês.
— Vou começar com o mensal. Se eu conseguir vir com frequência, depois mudo para o anual.
— Boa ideia! Antes do primeiro treino, você faz uma avaliação física gratuita com um professor.
translation:
— Good evening! I'd like some information about the gym's plans.
— Of course! Have you been to a gym before?
— Yes, but I stopped two years ago. Now I want to come back, because I spend the whole day sitting in the office.
— I see. The monthly plan costs a hundred and twenty reais. On the annual plan, you pay a hundred reais a month.
— I'll start with the monthly one. If I manage to come regularly, I'll switch to the annual one later.
— Good idea! Before your first workout, you'll have a free fitness assessment with an instructor.

questions.q: What is the conversation mainly about?
options: A man asking for a personal trainer
A man asking about the gym's hours
A man choosing a gym plan
A man complaining about the prices
questions.explain: He asks about 'os planos da academia' (the gym's plans) and decides: 'Vou começar com o mensal' (I'll start with the monthly one).

questions.q: Why does he want to go back to the gym?
options: He spends all day sitting at work
His doctor told him to lose weight
He wants to run a race next year
A friend has just joined the gym
questions.explain: He wants to come back 'porque passo o dia inteiro sentado no escritório' (because I spend the whole day sitting in the office).

questions.q: He says 'Se eu conseguir vir com frequência, depois mudo para o anual.' What does this tell us about him?
options: He plans to move to another city
He isn't sure he'll come often
He thinks the annual plan is bad
He only wants to train on Saturdays
questions.explain: Only if he manages to come 'com frequência' (regularly) will he move to the annual plan, so he isn't sure yet that he will.

topic: planning a waterfall trip by chat
title: Mudança de planos
text:
Camila: Gente, a previsão mudou: vai chover o sábado inteiro. Que tal deixar a cachoeira para domingo?
Thiago: Por mim, tudo bem. Posso levar o carro, mas só cabem quatro pessoas.
Bia: Sem problema. Eu e o Rafa vamos de ônibus. Tem um que sai da rodoviária às sete.
Camila: Perfeito! A trilha até a cachoeira leva uma hora, então levem tênis confortável e bastante água.
Thiago: E o almoço?
Camila: Cada um leva o que quiser, e a gente divide tudo lá.
translation:
Camila: Guys, the forecast has changed: it's going to rain all day Saturday. How about leaving the waterfall for Sunday?
Thiago: Fine by me. I can take the car, but only four people fit.
Bia: No problem. Rafa and I will go by bus. There's one that leaves the bus station at seven.
Camila: Perfect! The trail to the waterfall takes an hour, so bring comfortable sneakers and plenty of water.
Thiago: What about lunch?
Camila: Everyone brings whatever they like, and we share everything there.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the chat?
options: To choose a restaurant for Sunday
To plan a trip to a waterfall
To plan a birthday party at a park
To sell tickets for a bus tour
questions.explain: The friends organize a day out at 'a cachoeira' (the waterfall), talking about the trail, transport and lunch.

questions.q: Why does Camila suggest going on Sunday?
options: Thiago has to work on Saturday
The bus doesn't run on Saturday
Bia has an exam on Saturday
It's going to rain all Saturday
questions.explain: Camila writes 'a previsão mudou: vai chover o sábado inteiro' (the forecast has changed: it's going to rain all day Saturday).

questions.q: Thiago writes 'só cabem quatro pessoas'. What does he mean?
options: Only four people can come along
Four people have already said yes
His car only has room for four
He can drive for only four hours
questions.explain: 'Caber' means to fit: only four people fit in Thiago's car, so Bia and Rafa take the bus.

title: Entrega para a Carla
text:
Entregador: Boa noite! Estou no prédio com o seu pedido, mas o porteiro disse que nenhuma Carla mora no apartamento 72.
Carla: Que estranho! Qual é o endereço que aparece aí?
Entregador: Rua das Flores, 150.
Carla: Ah, desculpa! Eu me mudei mês passado e esqueci de atualizar o endereço no aplicativo. Agora moro na Rua das Flores, 510, a duas quadras daí.
Entregador: Sem problema, eu levo aí. Chego em cinco minutos.
Carla: Obrigada! Vou descer para te encontrar na portaria.
translation:
Driver: Good evening! I'm at the building with your order, but the doorman said no Carla lives in apartment 72.
Carla: How strange! What address is showing there?
Driver: Rua das Flores, 150.
Carla: Oh, sorry! I moved last month and forgot to update my address in the app. Now I live at Rua das Flores, 510, two blocks from there.
Driver: No problem, I'll bring it over. I'll be there in five minutes.
Carla: Thank you! I'll come down and meet you at the entrance.

questions.q: What is the problem in this chat?
options: The driver can't find the customer
The customer got the wrong food
The order is two hours late
The customer can't pay for the order
questions.explain: The driver is at the building, but 'o porteiro disse que nenhuma Carla mora no apartamento 72' (the doorman said no Carla lives in apartment 72).

questions.q: How long will the driver take to get to Carla?
options: About two minutes
About ten minutes
About fifteen minutes
About five minutes
questions.explain: The driver writes 'Chego em cinco minutos' (I'll be there in five minutes).

questions.q: What can we conclude about Rua das Flores, 150?
options: It is where Carla works
It is where Carla used to live
It is the restaurant's address
It is a friend's apartment
questions.explain: Carla writes 'Eu me mudei mês passado' (I moved last month) and forgot to update the app, so it still showed her old address.

topic: taking the wrong bus by mistake
title: A linha errada
text:
Numa segunda-feira, Letícia pegou o ônibus para o trabalho, mas estava tão distraída com o celular que não percebeu que era a linha errada. Quando olhou pela janela, estava num bairro que nunca tinha visto.

Ela desceu, irritada, e entrou numa padaria antiga para pedir informações. Lá, provou um pão de queijo incrível e conversou com o dono, um senhor muito simpático.

Naquele dia, chegou atrasada ao trabalho. Mas agora, toda sexta, sai mais cedo e pega a linha errada de propósito.
translation:
One Monday, Letícia took the bus to work, but she was so distracted by her phone that she didn't notice it was the wrong line. When she looked out of the window, she was in a neighborhood she had never seen.

She got off, annoyed, and went into an old bakery to ask for directions. There, she tried an amazing pão de queijo and talked to the owner, a very friendly older man.

That day, she got to work late. But now, every Friday, she leaves earlier and takes the wrong line on purpose.

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
options: A woman who misses an important meeting
A woman who is late and loses her job
A woman who opens a bakery in a new area
A woman who finds a bakery by mistake
questions.explain: Letícia gets on 'a linha errada' (the wrong line) and, in a neighborhood she doesn't know, discovers an old bakery with 'um pão de queijo incrível'.

questions.q: Why didn't Letícia notice she was on the wrong bus?
options: She was sleeping on the bus
She was busy with her phone
She was talking to a friend
She was reading a book
questions.explain: She 'estava tão distraída com o celular que não percebeu' (was so distracted by her phone that she didn't notice).

questions.q: Now Letícia takes the wrong line 'de propósito'. What does this mean?
options: She does it because she wants to
She does it because she is tired
She does it without noticing again
She does it because her bus is late
questions.explain: 'De propósito' means on purpose: she now 'sai mais cedo' (leaves earlier) so that she can take that line.

title: Alugo quarto
text:
ALUGO QUARTO PERTO DA UNIVERSIDADE
Quarto mobiliado num apartamento de três quartos, a dez minutos a pé do campus. Tem cama de solteiro, armário, escrivaninha e uma janela grande, com muita luz.
Você vai dividir a cozinha, a sala e o banheiro com duas estudantes de Medicina.

Aluguel: R$ 900,00 por mês, com água, luz e internet incluídas.
Não aceitamos animais.

Procuramos uma moça organizada que goste de silêncio para estudar.
Interessadas, mandem mensagem para a Júlia.
translation:
ROOM FOR RENT NEAR THE UNIVERSITY
Furnished room in a three-bedroom apartment, a ten-minute walk from the campus. It has a single bed, a wardrobe, a desk and a big window with lots of light.
You will share the kitchen, the living room and the bathroom with two medical students.

Rent: R$ 900.00 a month, with water, electricity and internet included.
We don't accept pets.

We are looking for a tidy young woman who likes quiet when she studies.
If you're interested, send Júlia a message.

questions.q: What is the advert for?
options: A room for rent in a shared apartment
A furnished apartment for a whole family
A house for rent near the beach
A parking space for rent on campus
questions.explain: The heading 'ALUGO QUARTO' means 'I'm renting out a room', and the new tenant 'vai dividir a cozinha, a sala e o banheiro' (will share the kitchen, living room and bathroom).

questions.q: What is included in the rent?
options: Only water and electricity
Internet and weekly cleaning
Breakfast, water and internet
Water, electricity and internet
questions.explain: The ad says 'com água, luz e internet incluídas'; on a Brazilian bill, 'luz' means electricity.

questions.q: Who would be the best match for this advert?
options: A male student from the campus
A quiet young woman with a small dog
A tidy young woman who likes quiet
A girl who plays drums at night
questions.explain: They want 'uma moça organizada que goste de silêncio para estudar' (a tidy young woman who likes quiet when she studies), and they don't accept pets.

title: Fora do escritório
text:
Assunto: Resposta automática – Fora do escritório
Olá!
Obrigado pela sua mensagem. Estou de férias até o dia 21 de julho e, durante esse período, não vou ler meus e-mails. Quando eu voltar, vou responder a todos o mais rápido possível.

Se o assunto for urgente, por favor, fale com a minha colega Beatriz Lima pelo ramal 214. Ela vai cuidar dos meus clientes enquanto eu estiver fora.

Atenciosamente,
Fernando Rocha
translation:
Subject: Automatic reply – Out of the office
Hello!
Thank you for your message. I'm on vacation until July 21, and during this period I won't be reading my emails. When I get back, I'll answer everyone as quickly as possible.

If the matter is urgent, please speak to my colleague Beatriz Lima on extension 214. She will look after my clients while I'm away.

Kind regards,
Fernando Rocha

questions.q: What kind of message is this?
options: A request for a meeting with a client
An invitation to his farewell party
An automatic reply about his vacation
A note saying he has changed jobs
questions.explain: The subject says 'Resposta automática' (automatic reply), and Fernando writes 'Estou de férias' (I'm on vacation).

questions.q: What should you do if your matter is urgent?
options: Call Fernando on his cell phone
Contact his colleague Beatriz
Wait for Fernando to reply
Write to the company's main office
questions.explain: He writes 'Se o assunto for urgente, por favor, fale com a minha colega Beatriz Lima' (please speak to my colleague Beatriz Lima).

questions.q: You can speak to Beatriz 'pelo ramal 214'. What is a 'ramal'?
options: A room number at the office
A personal cell phone number
A desk on another floor
A phone extension at work
questions.explain: You 'fale com' (speak to) Beatriz through a short number at the office: a 'ramal' is a phone extension.

topic: ordering party snacks for a birthday
title: Encomenda para a festa
text:
— Boa tarde! Queria encomendar salgadinhos para o aniversário da minha filha.
— Claro! Para quantas pessoas?
— Umas trinta. A festa é no sábado, às quatro.
— Para trinta pessoas, recomendo uns trezentos: coxinhas, bolinhas de queijo e enroladinhos de salsicha.
— Perfeito. Quanto fica?
— O cento custa sessenta reais, então fica cento e oitenta. Você paga metade agora, como sinal, e o resto quando vier buscar.
— Posso buscar no sábado de manhã?
— Pode, a partir das dez. Assim, ficam fresquinhos para a festa.
translation:
— Good afternoon! I'd like to order some party snacks for my daughter's birthday.
— Of course! For how many people?
— About thirty. The party is on Saturday, at four.
— For thirty people, I recommend about three hundred: coxinhas, cheese balls and sausage rolls.
— Perfect. How much will it be?
— A hundred costs sixty reais, so it comes to a hundred and eighty. You pay half now, as a deposit, and the rest when you come to pick them up.
— Can I pick them up on Saturday morning?
— Yes, from ten o'clock. That way, they'll be nice and fresh for the party.

questions.q: What is the customer doing?
options: Cancelling an order for a party
Complaining about a late order
Ordering a birthday cake
Ordering snacks for a party
questions.explain: The customer says 'Queria encomendar salgadinhos para o aniversário da minha filha' (I'd like to order party snacks for my daughter's birthday).

questions.q: How much will the customer pay in total?
options: 180 reais
60 reais
90 reais
300 reais
questions.explain: Each hundred ('o cento') costs sixty reais, so for three hundred snacks it 'fica cento e oitenta' (comes to a hundred and eighty).

questions.q: The customer pays half now 'como sinal'. What is a 'sinal' here?
options: A tip for the person serving
A discount for buying so many
A first payment to secure the order
A fee for delivering to the house
questions.explain: The customer pays 'metade agora, como sinal, e o resto quando vier buscar' (half now and the rest when picking up), so the 'sinal' is a deposit that holds the order.

title: Onde está o Pipoca?
text:
Todo dia, depois do almoço, o gato da Sônia, o Pipoca, saía de casa e só voltava à noite. O mais estranho era que ele não tocava mais na ração.

Um dia, Sônia resolveu segui-lo. O Pipoca atravessou a rua, pulou um muro e entrou numa casa amarela. Lá dentro, uma senhora o chamava de Tigrão e servia peixe para ele.

As duas acabaram ficando amigas, e o Pipoca continua com duas casas e dois nomes.
translation:
Every day after lunch, Sônia's cat, Pipoca, went out and only came back at night. The strangest thing was that he no longer touched his cat food.

One day, Sônia decided to follow him. Pipoca crossed the street, jumped over a wall and went into a yellow house. Inside, an older lady called him Tigrão and served him fish.

The two women ended up becoming friends, and Pipoca still has two homes and two names.

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
options: A cat that gets lost for a whole week
A cat that secretly has a second home
A woman who decides to adopt a second cat
Two neighbors who argue about a cat
questions.explain: Sônia follows Pipoca and finds that, in 'uma casa amarela' (a yellow house), a lady treats him as her own cat and calls him 'Tigrão'.

questions.q: When did Pipoca leave the house every day?
options: Early in the morning
Late at night
Right after lunch
Before dinner
questions.explain: The text says 'Todo dia, depois do almoço, o gato ... saía de casa' (every day after lunch the cat went out).

questions.q: What does 'ele não tocava mais na ração' mean?
options: He didn't eat his cat food anymore
He didn't let Sônia touch him anymore
He no longer slept in his bed
He spilled his cat food on the floor
questions.explain: 'Ração' is pet food: Pipoca stopped eating it at home because, at the yellow house, the lady 'servia peixe para ele' (served him fish).

topic: getting a cracked phone screen fixed
title: A tela quebrada
text:
— Bom dia! A tela do meu celular quebrou ontem. Dá para consertar?
— Deixa eu ver... Dá, sim, mas precisa trocar a tela inteira. Fica em trezentos e cinquenta reais.
— Puxa, é caro! Vale a pena consertar ou é melhor comprar um novo?
— Esse modelo ainda é bom. Um novo custa mais de dois mil.
— Tá bom, então. Fica pronto quando?
— Se deixar agora, fica pronto amanhã à tarde. Mas faça um backup das suas fotos antes, por segurança.
— Combinado!
translation:
— Good morning! My phone screen broke yesterday. Can it be fixed?
— Let me see... Yes, it can, but the whole screen needs replacing. It comes to three hundred and fifty reais.
— Gosh, that's expensive! Is it worth fixing, or is it better to buy a new one?
— This model is still good. A new one costs more than two thousand.
— All right, then. When will it be ready?
— If you leave it now, it'll be ready tomorrow afternoon. But back up your photos first, just to be safe.
— Deal!

questions.q: What is the conversation mainly about?
options: Buying a new phone in a shop
Returning a phone that doesn't work
Getting a broken phone screen fixed
Choosing a new plan for a phone
questions.explain: The customer says 'A tela do meu celular quebrou ontem' (my phone screen broke yesterday) and asks 'Dá para consertar?' (can it be fixed?).

questions.q: What does the shop worker say about a new phone?
options: It costs more than two thousand
It is on sale this week only
It comes with a free case
It would arrive in a week
questions.explain: The shop worker says 'Um novo custa mais de dois mil' (a new one costs more than two thousand).

questions.q: Why does the shop worker tell the customer to back up the photos?
options: The photos take up too much space
The customer asked how to do it
The shop wants to see the photos
The photos might get lost
questions.explain: 'Por segurança' means to be safe: the photos could be lost while the phone is being repaired, so a backup protects them.

title: A pizza do 81
text:
Fazia semanas que Gustavo dormia mal por causa do vizinho de cima, que tocava bateria até tarde. Ele queria reclamar, mas nunca tinha coragem.

Numa sexta à noite, o entregador trouxe por engano uma pizza do apartamento 81. Gustavo subiu para entregá-la, e quem abriu a porta foi um rapaz tímido, com baquetas na mão.

Os dois dividiram a pizza, conversaram muito e fizeram um acordo: dali em diante, o rapaz só tocaria até as nove.
translation:
For weeks Gustavo had been sleeping badly because of his upstairs neighbor, who played the drums until late. He wanted to complain, but he never had the courage.

One Friday night, the delivery man brought him a pizza for apartment 81 by mistake. Gustavo went upstairs to deliver it, and the person who opened the door was a shy young man with drumsticks in his hand.

The two of them shared the pizza, talked a lot and made a deal: from then on, the young man would only play until nine.

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
options: A man who moves to a quieter building
A wrong delivery that solves a problem
A neighbor who complains about a party
A pizza place that opens in the building
questions.explain: A pizza that arrives 'por engano' (by mistake) takes Gustavo upstairs, and the night ends with 'um acordo' (a deal).

questions.q: What did Gustavo and the young man agree on?
options: The drums would stop at nine p.m.
They would order pizza every Friday
Gustavo would take drum lessons
The young man would move out soon
questions.explain: Their deal is that 'dali em diante, o rapaz só tocaria até as nove' (from then on, the young man would only play until nine).

questions.q: 'Ele queria reclamar, mas nunca tinha coragem.' What does this tell us about Gustavo?
options: He didn't mind the noise at all
He had already complained twice
He was too busy to talk to anyone
He wasn't brave enough to complain
questions.explain: 'Coragem' is courage: Gustavo wanted to complain about the noise but never dared to.

title: Coleta seletiva
text:
COLETA SELETIVA: NOVOS DIAS
A partir de 1º de março, o caminhão da coleta seletiva vai passar no seu bairro às terças e sextas-feiras.

Separe o lixo reciclável (papel, plástico, metal e vidro) do lixo orgânico. Lave as embalagens antes de jogá-las fora e coloque tudo em sacos transparentes, para facilitar o trabalho dos coletores.

Atenção: óleo de cozinha, pilhas e remédios vencidos não devem ser colocados no lixo comum. Leve-os aos pontos de entrega indicados no site da prefeitura.
translation:
RECYCLING COLLECTION: NEW DAYS
From March 1, the recycling truck will come to your neighborhood on Tuesdays and Fridays.

Separate recyclable waste (paper, plastic, metal and glass) from organic waste. Wash packaging before throwing it away and put everything in clear bags, to make the collectors' work easier.

Attention: cooking oil, batteries and expired medicines must not be put in the regular trash. Take them to the drop-off points listed on the city hall's website.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the notice?
options: To ask people to throw less food away
To announce a new recycling center
To explain a new recycling schedule
To invite people to clean the streets
questions.explain: The heading is 'COLETA SELETIVA: NOVOS DIAS' (recycling collection: new days), and the truck will now come 'às terças e sextas-feiras' (on Tuesdays and Fridays).

questions.q: What should people do with packaging before throwing it away?
options: Fold it into very small pieces
Put it into black plastic bags
Take it to a collection point
Wash it before putting it out
questions.explain: The notice says 'Lave as embalagens antes de jogá-las fora' (wash the packaging before throwing it away).

questions.q: What are 'remédios vencidos'?
options: Medicines past their expiry date
Medicines that are very strong
Medicines sold without a prescription
Medicines that have been opened
questions.explain: 'Vencido' means expired: like batteries and cooking oil, old medicines must go to special drop-off points, not the regular trash.

topic: laptop charger left at a guesthouse
title: Quarto 12
text:
Assunto: Carregador esquecido no quarto 12
Olá, Dona Vera!
Meu nome é Henrique e fiquei hospedado na pousada com a minha família no último fim de semana. Infelizmente, só percebi em casa que tinha esquecido o carregador do notebook na tomada ao lado da cama.

Se vocês o encontrarem, poderiam enviá-lo pelo correio? Eu pago o frete, claro. Meu endereço é Rua Ipiranga, 230, apto. 41, Campinas – SP.

Aliás, adoramos a estadia, principalmente o café da manhã!
Um abraço,
Henrique
translation:
Subject: Charger forgotten in room 12
Hello, Dona Vera!
My name is Henrique, and I stayed at the guesthouse with my family last weekend. Unfortunately, I only realized at home that I had left my laptop charger in the socket next to the bed.

If you find it, could you send it by post? I'll pay the shipping, of course. My address is Rua Ipiranga, 230, apt. 41, Campinas – SP.

By the way, we loved our stay, especially the breakfast!
Best wishes,
Henrique

questions.q: Why is Henrique writing to Dona Vera?
options: To get back something he forgot
To return a towel he took by mistake
To ask them to post him a receipt
To send a gift to thank the owner
questions.explain: He writes that he 'tinha esquecido o carregador do notebook' (had left his laptop charger behind) at the guesthouse.

questions.q: When did Henrique stay at the guesthouse?
options: Last month
Two weeks ago
Last weekend
Over the holidays
questions.explain: He writes that he stayed at the guesthouse 'no último fim de semana' (last weekend).

questions.q: Henrique writes 'Eu pago o frete, claro.' What does he mean?
options: He will pick it up in person
He will cover the shipping cost
He will pay for an extra night
He already paid for the room
questions.explain: The 'frete' is the shipping cost: he asks them to send the charger 'pelo correio' (by post) and offers to pay for it.

title: As contas do mês
text:
Domingo, 30 de abril
Há um mês, decidi anotar todos os meus gastos num caderno, porque o meu salário nunca chegava até o fim do mês. Hoje somei tudo e levei um susto: gastei quase quatrocentos reais com comida por aplicativo! Achava que pedia pouco, mas, na verdade, pedia duas ou três vezes por semana.

A partir de amanhã, vou levar marmita para o trabalho e cozinhar mais nos fins de semana. Se eu conseguir economizar, quero fazer uma viagem em dezembro.
translation:
Sunday, April 30
A month ago, I decided to write down all my spending in a notebook, because my salary never lasted until the end of the month. Today I added it all up and got a shock: I spent almost four hundred reais on food from delivery apps! I thought I didn't order much, but in fact I ordered two or three times a week.

Starting tomorrow, I'm going to take a packed lunch to work and cook more at weekends. If I manage to save money, I want to take a trip in December.

questions.q: What is the diary entry mainly about?
options: Planning a trip for December
Learning to cook new recipes
Asking the boss for a higher salary
Finding out where the money goes
questions.explain: The writer decided 'anotar todos os meus gastos' (to write down all my spending) and, after a month, 'somei tudo' (added it all up).

questions.q: What did the writer spend almost 400 reais on?
options: Clothes bought on the internet
Taxi rides to and from work
Food delivered through an app
Lunches at a restaurant near work
questions.explain: The entry says 'gastei quase quatrocentos reais com comida por aplicativo' (I spent almost four hundred reais on food from apps).

questions.q: 'O meu salário nunca chegava até o fim do mês.' What does this mean?
options: The salary was paid late every month
The money ran out before the month ended
The salary went up at the end of the year
The writer was paid only once a year
questions.explain: Money that 'chega até o fim do mês' lasts the whole month; the writer's salary never did, which is why the spending notes began.

title: Jantar com os sogros
text:
Era a primeira vez que os pais do Lucas vinham jantar no apartamento novo, e Mariana queria impressioná-los com uma moqueca.

Mas, enquanto arrumava a mesa, sentiu cheiro de queimado: tinha esquecido a panela no fogo alto. Quando os sogros chegaram, ela estava quase chorando.

A sogra, porém, deu risada e contou que, no primeiro jantar com a família do marido, tinha queimado o arroz. No fim, pediram comida japonesa, e a noite foi ótima.
translation:
It was the first time Lucas's parents were coming to dinner at the new apartment, and Mariana wanted to impress them with a moqueca.

But while she was setting the table, she smelled something burning: she had left the pot on high heat. When her in-laws arrived, she was almost crying.

Her mother-in-law, however, laughed and told her that, at her first dinner with her husband's family, she had burned the rice. In the end, they ordered Japanese food, and the evening was great.

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
options: A couple who open a new restaurant
A dinner that goes wrong but ends well
A woman learning to cook from her mother
A family that moves to a new apartment
questions.explain: Mariana's moqueca for Lucas's parents burns, but in the end 'a noite foi ótima' (the evening was great).

questions.q: What did Mariana's mother-in-law tell her?
options: That moqueca was her favorite dish
That she should take cooking classes
That Lucas never liked fish very much
That she had burned the rice once too
questions.explain: The mother-in-law said that, at her first dinner with her husband's family, she 'tinha queimado o arroz' (had burned the rice).

questions.q: Why did the mother-in-law tell this story?
options: To make Mariana feel better
To show she is a better cook
To ask Mariana to cook rice
To complain about her husband
questions.explain: Mariana 'estava quase chorando' (was almost crying), and her mother-in-law laughed and shared a similar mistake to cheer her up.

title: A louça da pia
text:
Natália: Gente, precisamos conversar sobre a limpeza. A pia está cheia de louça desde domingo, e não fui eu que deixei.
Felipe: Foi mal, a maior parte é minha. Essa semana estou com muitas provas na faculdade.
Bruno: Entendo, mas todo mundo está ocupado. Que tal a gente fazer uma escala? Cada um fica responsável pela cozinha dois dias por semana.
Natália: Acho ótimo, desde que ninguém deixe louça suja para o dia seguinte.
Felipe: Combinado. Eu lavo tudo hoje, prometo!
translation:
Natália: Guys, we need to talk about the cleaning. The sink has been full of dishes since Sunday, and I wasn't the one who left them there.
Felipe: My bad, most of them are mine. This week I have a lot of exams at university.
Bruno: I understand, but everyone is busy. How about we make a schedule? Each of us is in charge of the kitchen two days a week.
Natália: I think that's great, as long as nobody leaves dirty dishes for the next day.
Felipe: Deal. I'll wash everything today, I promise!

questions.q: What is the chat mainly about?
options: Hiring someone to clean the apartment
Taking out the trash on time
Buying new dishes for the kitchen
A problem with washing the dishes
questions.explain: Natália writes 'precisamos conversar sobre a limpeza' because 'A pia está cheia de louça desde domingo' (the sink has been full of dishes since Sunday).

questions.q: What is Felipe busy with this week?
options: A new part-time job
Exams at university
Moving to a new city
A trip with his family
questions.explain: Felipe writes 'Essa semana estou com muitas provas na faculdade' (I have a lot of exams at university this week).

questions.q: Bruno suggests 'uma escala'. What is it?
options: A cleaning lady once a week
A new rule about cooking at night
A plan for taking turns to clean
A meeting to discuss the problem
questions.explain: Bruno explains it himself: 'Cada um fica responsável pela cozinha dois dias por semana' (each of us is in charge of the kitchen two days a week).

title: Antes do exame
text:
ORIENTAÇÕES PARA O EXAME DE SANGUE
• Para alguns exames, como o de glicose, é preciso fazer jejum de pelo menos oito horas. Nesse período, só é permitido beber água.
• Evite exercícios intensos no dia anterior e bebidas alcoólicas nos três dias antes do exame.
• Caso você tome algum remédio todos os dias, não pare de tomá-lo sem falar com o seu médico. Avise também a enfermeira antes da coleta.
• É importante que você traga um documento com foto e o pedido médico.
translation:
GUIDANCE FOR YOUR BLOOD TEST
• For some tests, such as the glucose test, you need to fast for at least eight hours. During this period, only water is allowed.
• Avoid intense exercise the day before and alcoholic drinks in the three days before the test.
• If you take a medicine every day, don't stop taking it without talking to your doctor. Also tell the nurse before your blood is taken.
• It is important that you bring a photo ID and the doctor's request form.

questions.q: What is the purpose of this text?
options: To explain how to read your results
To advertise a new clinic in town
To help patients get ready for a test
To list the prices of blood tests
questions.explain: The heading is 'ORIENTAÇÕES PARA O EXAME DE SANGUE' (guidance for the blood test), and each point says what to do before it.

questions.q: What should patients who take a medicine every day do?
options: Stop taking it three days before
Ask their doctor before stopping
Bring the medicine to the test
Skip it on the morning of the test
questions.explain: The text says 'não pare de tomá-lo sem falar com o seu médico' (don't stop taking it without talking to your doctor).

questions.q: What does 'fazer jejum' mean here?
options: To eat nothing for some time
To drink plenty of water
To sleep for eight hours
To avoid any kind of exercise
questions.explain: During the 'jejum', 'só é permitido beber água' (only water is allowed), so you eat nothing for at least eight hours.

topic: helping a stranger before an interview
title: A entrevista
text:
Embora estivesse atrasado para a entrevista, Rodrigo parou para ajudar uma senhora que não conseguia subir a escada do metrô com duas malas pesadas.

Chegou ao escritório dez minutos depois do horário, suado e convencido de que tinha perdido a vaga. Mas, quando entrou na sala, quase não acreditou: quem ia entrevistá-lo era a mesma senhora do metrô.

Ela sorriu e disse: “Fique tranquilo. Eu também me atrasei por causa daquelas malas.”
translation:
Although he was late for the interview, Rodrigo stopped to help a lady who couldn't get up the subway stairs with two heavy suitcases.

He arrived at the office ten minutes after the agreed time, sweaty and convinced that he had lost his chance at the job. But when he walked into the room, he could hardly believe it: the person who was going to interview him was the same lady from the subway.

She smiled and said, “Don't worry. I was late too, because of those suitcases.”

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
options: A man who gets lost on the subway
A good deed before a job interview
A woman who loses her suitcases
A man who turns down a job offer
questions.explain: On the way to 'a entrevista' (the interview), Rodrigo stops to help 'uma senhora' with heavy suitcases, although he is late.

questions.q: Who was going to interview Rodrigo?
options: The woman he had helped
A man he knew from school
A woman from his old job
The manager's young assistant
questions.explain: When he entered the room, 'quem ia entrevistá-lo era a mesma senhora do metrô' (the person interviewing him was the same lady from the subway).

questions.q: When he arrived, Rodrigo was 'convencido de que tinha perdido a vaga'. What did he think?
options: That he had lost his bag on the subway
That he had come to the wrong office
That he had lost his chance at the job
That the lady had taken his seat
questions.explain: A 'vaga' is a job opening: arriving late and sweaty, he was sure he had lost his chance of getting the job.

topic: hotel booking for the wrong month
title: Na recepção do hotel
text:
— Boa noite. Tenho uma reserva em nome de Cláudia Martins.
— Um momento... Senhora, aqui consta que a sua reserva é para outubro.
— Não pode ser! Reservei para setembro, e tenho o e-mail de confirmação aqui.
— Peço desculpas, deve ter sido um erro no sistema. O quarto que a senhora escolheu está ocupado, mas posso oferecer um quarto maior pelo mesmo preço, caso não se importe de ficar no último andar.
— Se tiver vista para o mar, não me importo nem um pouco!
translation:
— Good evening. I have a reservation in the name of Cláudia Martins.
— One moment... Madam, it says here that your reservation is for October.
— That can't be! I booked for September, and I have the confirmation email here.
— I apologize; it must have been a system error. The room you chose is taken, but I can offer you a bigger room for the same price, if you don't mind staying on the top floor.
— If it has a sea view, I don't mind at all!

questions.q: What is the problem at the hotel?
options: Her room is dirty and noisy
She has lost her booking email
Her booking is for the wrong month
The hotel has no rooms left at all
questions.explain: The receptionist says 'aqui consta que a sua reserva é para outubro', but Cláudia says 'Reservei para setembro' (I booked for September).

questions.q: What does the receptionist offer?
options: A refund and a free dinner
A room in another hotel nearby
A discount on her next visit
A bigger room at the same price
questions.explain: The receptionist says 'posso oferecer um quarto maior pelo mesmo preço' (I can offer a bigger room for the same price).

questions.q: What can we conclude from Cláudia's last sentence?
options: She would rather have a lower floor
She'll take the room if it faces the sea
She wants to speak to the manager
She is going to look for another hotel
questions.explain: 'Se tiver vista para o mar, não me importo nem um pouco' means that, if the room has a sea view, she doesn't mind the top floor at all.

topic: asking to change course class times
title: Mudança de turma
text:
Assunto: Mudança de turma – Curso de Fotografia
Prezada Sra. Helena,
Sou aluna da turma de terça de manhã do curso de fotografia. Como comecei num novo emprego esta semana, não vou mais conseguir assistir às aulas nesse horário.

Gostaria de saber se seria possível passar para a turma de quinta à noite. Caso não haja vagas, aceitaria fazer o curso no próximo semestre, desde que pudesse usar o valor que já paguei.

Fico no aguardo da sua resposta.
Atenciosamente,
Lívia Campos
translation:
Subject: Class change – Photography Course
Dear Ms. Helena,
I am a student in the Tuesday morning class of the photography course. As I started a new job this week, I will no longer be able to attend classes at that time.

I would like to know whether it would be possible to move to the Thursday evening class. If there are no places, I would accept doing the course next semester, as long as I could use the amount I have already paid.

I look forward to your reply.
Kind regards,
Lívia Campos

questions.q: Why is Lívia writing to Helena?
options: To cancel the course and get a refund
To complain about the Tuesday teacher
To sign up for a new photography course
To ask to change to another class time
questions.explain: She asks 'se seria possível passar para a turma de quinta à noite' (whether it would be possible to move to the Thursday evening class).

questions.q: Why can't Lívia go to class on Tuesday mornings anymore?
options: She has just started a new job
She is moving to another city
She has classes at university
She has to take care of her son
questions.explain: She writes 'Como comecei num novo emprego esta semana' (as I started a new job this week).

questions.q: Lívia writes 'desde que pudesse usar o valor que já paguei'. What does she mean?
options: She wants all her money back now
She'll wait if her payment still counts
She is happy to pay the full price again
She thinks the course is too expensive
questions.explain: 'Desde que' means 'as long as': she would wait for next semester only if 'o valor que já paguei' (the amount I've already paid) counts for it.

topic: getting lost on New Year's Eve
title: Réveillon em Copacabana
text:
No Réveillon, Caio e três amigos foram ver os fogos em Copacabana. Antes de saírem, Aline propôs um plano: se alguém se perdesse na multidão, todos se encontrariam no posto 5 à uma da manhã. Caio achou a ideia exagerada e riu dela.

Pouco depois da meia-noite, adivinhe quem se perdeu? Sem sinal no celular, Caio andou sem rumo pela areia durante quase uma hora. À uma em ponto, chegou ao posto 5, onde os amigos o esperavam. “Exagerada, né?”, brincou Aline.
translation:
On New Year's Eve, Caio and three friends went to see the fireworks in Copacabana. Before they left, Aline suggested a plan: if anyone got lost in the crowd, everyone would meet at lifeguard post 5 at one in the morning. Caio thought the idea was over the top and laughed at her.

Shortly after midnight, guess who got lost? With no signal on his phone, Caio wandered aimlessly along the sand for almost an hour. At one o'clock sharp, he arrived at post 5, where his friends were waiting for him. “Over the top, huh?” Aline joked.

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
options: Caio getting lost on New Year's Eve
A party where the fireworks fail
Four friends who miss the fireworks
A trip to Rio that gets cancelled
questions.explain: At the fireworks in Copacabana, 'adivinhe quem se perdeu?' (guess who got lost?): Caio.

questions.q: What was the problem with Caio's phone?
options: The battery was dead
It fell into the sea
The screen was broken
It had no signal
questions.explain: The text says 'Sem sinal no celular' (with no signal on his phone), so Caio 'andou sem rumo pela areia' (wandered aimlessly along the sand).

questions.q: At the end, Aline jokes: “Exagerada, né?” What does she mean?
options: That Caio worries far too much
That the fireworks were too loud
That her plan was useful after all
That they should go home right now
questions.explain: Caio had thought her idea 'exagerada' (over the top), but he found his friends at 'o posto 5' as planned, so Aline teases him with his own word.
